modelName: S32-A — S28 surface + leakage-safe hierarchical credibility anchors (pre-PAV)

surfaceModel.prediction: One constrained log($/ct) surface; no champion blending.

trainingData.sourcePolicy: Clean Segment A only. Do not train S28 from starsgem-index.json or the raw XLS.

constraints.carat: coefficients on log-carat bases are projected >= 0, so $/ct is nondecreasing with carat.
constraints.caratStrictFloor: raw log-carat slope is projected >= 0.02, so larger carat has a tiny strict scarcity premium even when sheet rows are flat.
constraints.magicWeights: threshold approach ramps and exact/above-threshold steps are projected >= 0, so the model can learn 1.9ct < 2ct and 3.9ct < 4ct without using a smooth-only equation.
constraints.clarity: clarityRank coefficient is projected <= 0, so worse clarity cannot increase price.
constraints.color: colorRank coefficient is projected <= 0, so worse white color cannot increase price.
constraints.gradeSizeInteractions: colorPremium and clarityPremium use (worst rank - grade rank) * log1p(carat) and are projected >= 0, so better-grade premiums can grow with carat without making worse grades cheaper as size rises.
constraints.growth: HPHT coefficient is projected >= 0, so HPHT cannot price below CVD.
constraints.shapeAndCutCaratInteractions: Supported shapes and cuts receive nonnegative extra carat/magic-weight terms, so carat scarcity can differ by cut/shape without breaking global monotonicity.
constraints.dimensions: shape-normalized L/W, table, and depth deviations are projected <= 0.
constraints.vintage: Disabled in v0.4 so live predictions and training metrics use the same surface instead of forcing every deployed prediction to the current-row edge.

surfaceModel.caveat: Prototype uses a linear constrained surface with ridge shrinkage. It is meant to test the single-surface monotone approach before browser deployment.

sparseP90Ok.description: Sparse p90 APE not materially worse than S26/S30 (+3pp)

monotonicity.description: Monotonicity violations (pre-PAV — warning only at S32-A; hard gate at S32-C)
monotonicity.note: Will be fixed in S32-C with PAV lattice projection

princessNotWorse.description: Princess not worse than S31 (warning gate at S32-A)
